data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to add Facebook login and user profile information to your app.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to log into a Flutter application using their Facebook accounts. It provides access tokens, user profile information, profile image URLs, and email addresses.
use_when: You want to allow users to sign in or sign up using their Facebook accounts.
Your application targets both Android and iOS platforms.
avoid_when: You do not require Facebook authentication in your application.
You prefer using a backend-as-a-service provider like Firebase Authentication to handle all social logins.
strengths: Includes user profile and email retrieval capabilities.
Supports Swift Package Manager (SPM) alongside CocoaPods on iOS.
Up-to-date with recent Facebook Android and iOS SDK versions.
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration on both Android (XML resources, Manifest, Key Hashes) and iOS (Info.plist).
Limited Login mode on iOS requires additional OIDC token validation for server-side verification.
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Facebook app, configuring Android strings.xml, AndroidManifest.xml, release/debug key hashes, and editing iOS Info.plist with URL schemes and App IDs.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are already using Firebase for backend services and want an integrated authentication system that supports Facebook login.
